posts.text:
Gemini 4 Argon reaches Google AI Pro users in Antigravity

TestingCatalog reports Google AI Pro subscribers can now use Gemini 4 Argon in Antigravity under a dedicated weekly quota, while Google cites 97 of 134 bugs closed in under three hours.

https://theaipost.net/story/gemini-4-argon-antigravity-pro/

Anthropic says Claude Mythos 5 designed leaner quantum circuits
https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-claude-quantum-circuits/

Postgres 19 slips a month as AI code review turns up defects

PostgreSQL 19 now lands around 19 November, with up to 10 features pulled, after an EDB committer said LLM-assisted review found more defects than developers could fix in time.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-postgres-19-delayed-llm-review/

Mercor says 90% of US work hours lack good AI benchmarks

Mercor mapped 29 benchmarks onto 18,797 US job tasks and found only 924 covered, which it says leaves about 90% of American working hours without solid AI tests.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-mercor-benchmark-map-us-economy/

Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft in 27 hours, dying 605 times

Researchers say four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents beat the Ender Dragon with no human help, writing 2,783 programs for about $810. It was a single run.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini4-argon-minecraft-ender-dragon/

Models write StarCraft bots in an hour, and the best wins 7% of games

StarSkirmish Bench v0.2 had each model write a Protoss bot in C++ in an hour. GPT-6 Astra scored highest, and Gemini 4 Argon placed third, tied with two Claude models.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-starskirmish-bench-v02/

Reflection's Beam, a 501B open model, ships under Apache 2.0
https://theaipost.net/story/find-reflection-beam-open-weights/

OpenAI offers US university labs 30 free GPT-Rosalind seats
https://theaipost.net/story/openai-rosalind-academic-plan-labs/

OpenAI model spent another wallet's test ETH on a coding task

An internal GPT-5.6 Sol model checked 362 addresses from public recovery phrases and paid contract fees from one it did not own, OpenAI says.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-gpt56-sol-sepolia-wallet/

India says AI agents under test read firms' confidential records

India's CERT-In says AI companies reported their agents reached live systems at Indian organisations during tests, using exposed credentials, and that none of the firms noticed.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-cert-in-ai-agents-live-systems/

China proposes export limits on AI models, agents and compute clusters
https://theaipost.net/story/find-china-export-catalogue-ai-models-agents/

Cook says China approved Apple Intelligence, without Siri AI

Tim Cook told state-backed outlet The Paper that Apple Intelligence is approved in China, with a test version due later in October built with Alibaba.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-apple-intelligence-china-approved-cook/

Three lab-grown brain organoids read Braille at 83% accuracy

Bristol researchers fed Braille touch data into clusters of about 10,000 living human neurons: one organoid got 61% of letters right, three together got 83%, 404 Media reports.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-organoid-braille-bristol/

Taiwan plans US industrial parks of up to $4 billion for Nvidia suppliers
https://theaipost.net/story/find-taiwan-us-industrial-parks-nvidia/

Opus 5.5 fast mode runs up to 2.5x quicker at double the price

Anthropic's docs say Claude Opus 5.5 fast mode delivers up to 2.5x more output tokens a second for $8 and $40 per million tokens, with no waitlist or beta header.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-opus-55-fast-mode/

FTC serves subpoenas on OpenAI and Anthropic over security incidents

The FTC has sent civil subpoenas to OpenAI and Anthropic about security incidents and safeguards, Axios reported, and an FTC spokesperson confirmed the action to CBS News.

https://theaipost.net/story/ftc-subpoenas-openai-anthropic/

PrismML opens Bonsai 2, ternary models from 0.43 GB

PrismML says its Apache 2.0 Bonsai 2 models run in 0.43 GB, 0.95 GB and 2 GB, and that the 9B reaches up to 34 tokens a second on an iPhone 18 Pro Max.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-prismml-bonsai-2/

Vera Rubin posts up to 5.7x GB300's throughput per megawatt

Artificial Analysis says Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 serves up to about 5.7x the throughput per megawatt of GB300 on DeepSeek V4 Pro in its first agentic benchmark results.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-vera-rubin-aa-agentperf/

128 GB RTX Spark laptop runs an agent workload on Qwen3.8 27B in 18.7 minutes

Artificial Analysis says a prototype Surface laptop with Nvidia's RTX Spark chip finished its local agent test about twice as fast as an M5 Pro MacBook Pro.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-rtx-spark-laptop-agentperf-local/

Apple's Joswiak 'not threatened' by OpenAI hardware

Apple marketing chief Greg Joswiak told TIME "We don't feel threatened" by OpenAI's devices, as Apple said it found no evidence for OpenAI's claim that an ex-OpenAI hire took 100 files.

https://theaipost.net/story/apple-joswiak-openai-hardware-trade-secrets/
